title: Fleet Health
description: Fleet-wide view of all hypervisors and VMs, surfacing VMs that are down or outliers.

panels.title: Hypervisors reporting
panels.description: Hosts with data in the last 2 minutes.

panels.title: VMs not running
panels.description: Defined VMs in any state other than running.

panels.title: Should be running
panels.description: Not running although marked autostart -- most likely an outage.

panels.title: VM NICs dropping packets
panels.description: virtio/tap interfaces with any rx/tx drops in the last 15m.

panels.title: VMs not running
panels.description: Every defined VM that isn't running, from the libvirt_vms OpenMetrics source. Autostart VMs are expected to be up, so they're flagged red.

panels.title: Sustained high CPU (≥ 85% avg over 15m)
panels.description: CPU as a percentage of the VM's own vCPUs. A VM pinned here may need more vCPUs or has a runaway process.

panels.title: Memory pressure (≥ 90% of assigned)
panels.description: qemu process RSS on the host as a percentage of the VM's assigned memory.

panels.title: Packet drops (last 15m)
panels.description: virtio/tap interfaces only; SR-IOV VFs are not visible to libvirt.

panels.title: VM state
panels.description: State of every defined VM over time. Green running; yellow paused/suspended; orange blocked/shutting down; red shut off; dark red crashed; purple unknown. Gaps mean no data from that host.
